PROJECTS.title: AcuPulse-RT: Electro-Acupuncture & Meridian Bio-Impedance System
PROJECTS.subtitle: Quantitative Acupoint Conductance & Micro-Current Neuro-Modulation
PROJECTS.summary: Investigated quantitative skin-conductance mapping across classical meridian acupoints paired with precision biphasic electro-acupuncture stimulation for autonomic nervous system balance and pain modulation.
architecture: Maps galvanic skin response and meridian bio-impedance gradients to localize low-resistance acupoint nodes objectively.
Delivers charge-balanced biphasic micro-current waveforms (2Hz endorphin-release to 100Hz segmental analgesia protocols).
Integrates real-time Heart Rate Variability (HRV) feedback to quantify parasympathetic activation during holistic therapy.

specs.Institution: Gampaha Wickramarachchi University of Indigenous Medicine

PROJECTS.title: NeuroVagal Wearable Auricular & Bio-Telemetry Sensor Patch
PROJECTS.subtitle: Non-Invasive Vagus Nerve Stimulation & Continuous Autonomic Tracking
PROJECTS.summary: Conceptualized a minimalist wearable bio-telemetry cradle and auricular neuro-modulation patch uniting traditional ear-acupoint therapeutics with modern biomedical signal acquisition.
architecture: Targets the cymba conchae auricular branch of the vagus nerve with ultra-gentle transcutaneous micro-pulses.
Captures continuous photoplethysmography (PPG) and electrodermal activity (EDA) to track stress recovery curves.
Closed-loop algorithm adapts stimulation intensity dynamically based on real-time respiratory sinus arrhythmia.

specs.Sensors: 24-Bit Analog Front-End ECG / PPG + Galvanic Skin
specs.Safety: Optically Isolated Current Limiter (< 4 mA Peak)

PROJECTS.title: PhytoStandard: Indigenous Botanical Extraction & Bio-Assay Matrix
PROJECTS.subtitle: Evidence-Based Standardization of Holistic Therapeutic Formulations
PROJECTS.summary: Structured analytical protocols bridging Sri Lankan indigenous medical pharmacopeia with modern phytochemical profiling, thermal extraction control, and anti-inflammatory bio-assays.
architecture: Correlates traditional holistic therapeutic indications with secondary metabolite markers (polyphenols, alkaloids, terpenoids).
Establishes reproducible temperature-controlled distillation and solvent-free extraction curves to preserve volatile bioactives.
Documents synergistic combinations pairing topical herbal therapeutics with meridian acupuncture protocols.

PROJECTS.title: MeridianMap 3D: Digital Acupoint Atlas & Clinical Telemetry UI
PROJECTS.subtitle: Interactive Anatomical Meridian Visualization & Patient Outcome System
PROJECTS.summary: Designed a high-contrast Swiss-editorial clinical interface that visualizes 361 classical acupuncture points, anatomical depth vectors, and session-over-session patient pain & mobility scores.
architecture: Interactive 3D wireframe meridian pathways linking organ-system patterns with modern dermatome and myofascial chains.
Tracks Visual Analog Scale (VAS) pain reduction, sleep quality, and autonomic biomarkers across treatment cycles.
Provides evidence-graded clinical protocol cards combining acupuncture needling depths with holistic lifestyle therapeutics.

specs.Metrics: VAS Pain Index, HRV RMSSD, Range-of-Motion (ROM)
specs.Standard: WHO International Standard Terminologies on Traditional Medicine

PROJECTS.title: BioWave-SIM: Closed-Loop Electro-Therapeutic Waveform Analyzer
PROJECTS.subtitle: Computational Modeling of Tissue Impedance & Nerve Activation Thresholds
PROJECTS.summary: Developed an interactive biomedical waveform simulator that models skin-electrode double-layer capacitance and optimizes closed-loop stimulation pulses to eliminate tissue polarization.
architecture: Models the Cole-Cole equivalent electrical circuit of human epidermal and subcutaneous tissue at acupoint sites.
Optimizes proportional-integral current regulation so pulse amplitude stays constant despite dynamic perspiration changes.
Visualizes real-time A-beta and A-delta nerve fiber recruitment thresholds across varying pulse widths (50–400 μs).

PROJECTS.title: Integrative Clinical Pathway & Holistic Outcome Topology
PROJECTS.subtitle: Multi-Modal Diagnostic Matrix for Indigenous & Biomedical Care
PROJECTS.summary: Constructed a structured clinical decision and outcome-tracking framework that harmonizes traditional constitution assessment with modern biomedical lab markers and physical rehabilitation.
architecture: Four-pathway integrative triage combining pulse/meridian diagnostics with objective hematological and autonomic baselines.
Synchronizes acupuncture scheduling, individualized phytotherapeutic regimens, and rehabilitative movement therapy.
Generates standardized clinical research datasets ready for peer-reviewed biomedical publication and cross-center trials.
